title: Period rebuild and correction-equivalence vectors v1
description: Each case holds one participant's contribution ledger for one period, the per-view correction rows that record the same corrections, and the total the sealed generation published. scripts/repository/validate_planning_artifacts.py folds the ledger, folds the correction rows independently, and requires the two to agree with each other and with the recorded total. A case whose recorded total disagrees fails, so the fixture cannot confirm itself. D-263 composes a period as the checked sum of additions minus the checked sum of retractions and rejects rather than clamps when the retractions exceed what they correct; that rejection is a case here rather than a sentence.

contributions.description: Rows of score_contributions for this participant and period, in insert order. Nothing here is ever edited: a correction appends.

corrections.description: Rows of ranking_corrections for the same participant, period and view. They are the per-view record of the same corrections the ledger carries, and the rebuild requires the two to agree.

token_burn_delta.description: Signed, and its sign is fixed by the origin: `retraction` is negative and nothing else is. planning-schema.sql carries the same rule as a CHECK, so a row that disagrees cannot be inserted.

superseded.description: True when superseded_by_contribution_id is set. A superseded row stays in the ledger and stops counting; it is not deleted, because the arithmetic that produced a published standing has to remain readable.

token_burn_total.description: The total the sealed generation published, or null when the rebuild rejects.

reason_code.description: Resolves in packages/schemas/reason-codes-v1.json. Null exactly when the outcome is rebuild.
